text: Could you make me a professional headshot from this pic? I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while. The thing I nearly forgot to mention in the middle of all this is that I'd like it to be square. I'm just a little nervous about how it'll turn out, since I don't usually know what makes a good headshot.
